Context cites Ansem's past criticisms of the launchpad's rewards/fees and a New York federal class action with racketeering claims advancing. Reactions split; unverified plea from the X News summary, not a primary disclosure. Continues Ansem / Pump.fun drama already on the board.

news.headline: X News: Crypto influencer Ethan claims $142K earned from Pump.fun callouts
news.detail: X News story (updated ~23:26 Berlin) summarizes that influencer Ethan posted a screenshot boasting about $142,474 all-time earned from Pump.fun callout promotions in USDC; critics called it dumping on followers, while Bubblemaps analyzed 49 of his callouts estimating about $125,000 from rewards and timely trades via connected wallets (figures from the X News summary, not a primary filing).

news.headline: Pump.fun co-founder Alon expands Callout Rewards to higher-cap tokens and non-SOL traders
news.detail: Pump.fun co-founder @a1lon9 (433,139 followers) posted at 23:09 Berlin that over the past few days the Callout Rewards program got major changes aimed at (1) incentivizing calls on higher market-cap tokens and (2) rewarding users from other ecosystems such as perps and crosschain (non-SOL). Early engagement at scan: about 8,307 impressions, 66 likes, 11 reposts, 66 replies, 3 bookmarks. Amplifiers (@popmemecoin) framed it as expanding beyond Pumpfun.

news.headline: X News: Sahil shares screenshots in Ansem Solana feud, sparking doxxing claims
news.detail: X news summary (updated ~22:04 Berlin): Sahil posted photos of a couple plus WhatsApp messages tied to his public accusations against trader Ansem (@blknoiz06), with reactions ranging from shock and doxxing concerns to jokes about relationship drama in Solana memecoin circles. Continues the Ansem / Pump.fun speculation already on the board. Unverified drama summary from X news, not a primary disclosure.

news.headline: X News: Thinking Cat $HMM token joins Robinhood app assets
news.detail: X news summary (updated ~21:52 Berlin): $HMM (Thinking Cat), launched in July on Robinhood Chain via the Pons ecosystem, was added to Robinhood app assets for users to view. Influencers including CryptoKaleo cheered the visibility; the summary cites price near $0.01 with about a $12M market cap, and notes some caution that this is visibility (like past tokens $AI and $PRIORS) rather than full trading.

news.headline: X News: Ansem faces accusations of hidden wallet schemes amid Pump.fun reward talk
news.detail: X news summary (updated ~21:27 Berlin): Bubblemaps said it plans to expose a major KOL for allegedly drawing copy traders to public wallets while selling via hidden side wallets, farming rewards, and bundling tokens. Community speculation centered on trader @blknoiz06 (Ansem), with talk of Pump.fun trading, large shorts, and past paid promos. Unverified accusations from the X news summary, not a primary disclosure; continues earlier Ansem / Pump.fun reward speculation already on the board.

news.headline: BeInCrypto: India ED raids CoinDCX and Delta Exchange over offshore crypto routing
news.detail: Verified @beincrypto (87,615 followers) posted at 20:18 Berlin that India's Enforcement Directorate searched three offices tied to CoinDCX and Delta Exchange over alleged foreign exchange violations, claiming customer rupee deposits were converted into $USDT for offshore routing (text cut off). Outlet-reported regulatory action, not a memecoin-specific event.

news.headline: X News: Coinbase opens spot trading for Collector Crypt (CARD)
news.detail: X news summary (updated ~20:10 Berlin): Coinbase opened spot trading for Collector Crypt (CARD) on 6 Nov 2026 after liquidity requirements in supported regions. Native as CARDS on Solana, it tokenizes graded physical trading cards into redeemable NFTs (gacha packs, trade, or redeem vaulted cards); platform cited at $433.5M Q3 sales. Auction mode for 10 minutes then full orders; availability varies by jurisdiction. Figures and details are from the X news summary.

news.headline: X News: Speculation that Ansem may have a Pump.fun deal
news.detail: X news summary (updated ~20:11 Berlin): Claims circulate that trader @blknoiz06 (Ansem) cut a deal with Pump.fun, citing boosts of low-follower accounts that then post pro-platform content. Tied to Pump.fun callout USDC rewards and talk around $ANSEM sliding from about $0.40 peak to $0.05. Unverified speculation from the X news summary, not a primary disclosure.

news.headline: Backpack: $MNST (Monster Beverage share token) listed on Solana with Sunrise
news.detail: Verified @BackpackOnchain (14,121 followers) posted at 20:17 Berlin that $MNST issued by Backpack Securities is listed on Solana with @Sunrise, redeemable 1:1 for Monster Beverage shares and transferable to traditional brokerages. This is a tokenized equity product, not a memecoin launch.

news.headline: X News: Solana Labs launches Leap mobile trading app (stocks, crypto, memecoins)
news.detail: X news summary (updated earlier today, still current): Solana Labs launched Leap, an iPhone app for trading tokenized stocks, ETFs, commodities, currencies, crypto, and memecoins on Solana with onchain trades and no platform fees for now. Built by the Dialect team after acquisition; plans to burn SOL from future fees. Early iPhone access via TestFlight; Android later; U.S. users can't trade tokenized stocks. Details from the X news summary.

news.headline: X News: Trader Ansem cites large Pump.fun callout rewards on a SOL short
news.detail: X news summary (updated ~19:44 Berlin): trader @blknoiz06 (Ansem) shared a ~1M SOL short that reportedly netted about $60K in trading profit plus roughly $35K–$36K in Pump.fun Callout Rewards USDC for posting the call publicly, with annualized rewards framed near $12.6M in screenshots circulating in the story. Supporters call it pay for natural posts; critics say it favors audience size and blurs analysis with paid promotion. Figures are from the X news summary, not a primary exchange disclosure.

news.headline: Pump.fun lets callers time callouts with their buy
news.detail: Official @Pumpfun post (about 19:34 Berlin) says callers can now post a callout alongside their buy so the callout price matches the entry, instead of having to buy first and then write the idea (which made callouts look higher than the real buy). Post had about 10.4K impressions, 75 likes, 8 reposts, and 41 replies at scan time.
